gamejolt.status.failed: MISHAP — CHECK YER NAME N' CODE
valley_skull_1: I have to wake up BF, but how, matey?
valley_skull_2: Reckon I'll be huntin' down the other parts...
valley_gary1_1: Yer friend ain't just sleepin', lass.
valley_gary1_2: Whatever sent him to the depths.....
valley_gary2_1: A swindlin' copy o' somethin' every soul loves,
valley_gary2_2: but close enough to fool ye,
valley_gary4_1: There be no more to it,
sharpy.line.01: Why'd ye call me here, Ivo?
sharpy.line.02: Sorry fer disturbin' ye, Exetior, but ye may need t' look at this.
sharpy.line.04: By me machine, someone be tryin' t'... invade this domain from another world!
sharpy.line.05: Giant rings been sendin' objects t' this place fer quite a while now; the last documented report was from ten minutes ago.
sharpy.line.06: The energy from these rings be on another level... somethin' unexpected might come out o' this.
sharpy.line.07: Interestin'... I never thought anyone had the gall t' try an' enter here without me permission.
sharpy.line.08: Come with me, Ivo, I need ye t' help figure out exactly what be happenin'.
sharpy.line.09: Oh c'mon, mateys, sing with me! It'll be fun!
sharpy.line.12: UGHH! Ye scallywags be SOOOOO BORIN'!
sharpy.line.15: What fine timin'! Look what just appeared!
sharpy.line.17: It just came out o' some big ring a couple minutes ago.
sharpy.line.18: Seems there be some sort o' energy radiatin' from the box; perhaps I can track where it came from...
sharpy.line.20: H-Hey, should we maybe test it? Ye know... singin' an' such... Just ye an' me-
valley_tutorial_glide: PRESS AGAIN IN TH' AIR T' GLIDE
valley_tutorial_story_1: Ye woke up with no sign o' yer boyfriend...
valley_tutorial_story_2: But ye feel like ye be watched at every turn.
valley_tutorial_story_3: In this lifeless place, search fer yer loved one while hidin' from th' unknown. But beware, $IT$ won't let ye go easy.
valley_tutorial_story_4: Seek #Safe Spots# an' #Small Entrances#. Do NOT let $him$ find ye.

prey_ending_4: Best go find out what be goin' on!

warning_text_main:
AHOY MATEY.

'Fore ye set sail any further, ye must know this voyage holds flashin' lights and fits.

If ye be feelin' seasick or triggered by such sights, DO NOT PLAY THIS AND ABANDON SHIP.

Also, if yer vessel be a rickety one, ye may run into trouble loadin' the cargo. Consider lowerin' the shader quality or sailin' on a vessel with more RAM.

Viewer discretion be advised, arrr.
